name: TC-18-cross-workflow-integration
description: TC-18: Cross-Workflow Integration — Navigate through MR → WO, MR → PR, and WO → Safety Permit chains

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.1 — Maintenance Request (Integration Source)
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Maintenance Request. MRs serve as the starting point for cross-workflow integration chains: MR → Work Order, MR → Purchase Request.

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.1 — MR Integration Overview
doc_metadata.caption: Approved maintenance requests can trigger: 'Generate Maintenance Order' (creates MO + WO) and 'Create Purchase Request' (creates PR for parts). These server actions link entities across modules.

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.3 — Work Order (Integration Hub)
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Work Order. Work orders link to safety permits, labor, parts, equipment, and activities. WOs with LOTO Required = Yes should have linked safety permits.

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.3 — Work Order Integration Points
doc_metadata.caption: Work orders serve as the central hub for cross-module integration. Child records include labor, parts, equipment, activities, and safety permits.

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.3 — Safety Permits (WO Integration)
doc_metadata.caption: Safety permits are linked to work orders requiring hazardous work authorization. The WO → Safety Permit chain ensures proper safety compliance.

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.3 — Safety Permit → Work Order Link
doc_metadata.caption: Safety permits show the linked work order in their detail view. Active permits must be verified before work order execution can begin.

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.2 — Purchase Request (MR Integration)
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Purchase Request. PRs can be generated from maintenance requests to procure required parts and materials.

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.2 — MR → PR Integration
doc_metadata.caption: Purchase requests generated from maintenance requests carry the requestor, site, department, and required items from the source MR.

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.5 — Vendor Performance
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Vendor. Vendor performance is automatically calculated based on purchase receipt delivery data.

doc_metadata.title: TC-18.5 — Vendor Performance Metrics
doc_metadata.caption: The vendor list shows delivery ratings, on-time delivery percentages, quality scores, and total orders. These metrics are auto-calculated from purchase receipt records.
